items.adjacentText: The crowd-pleasing salad of crisp romaine leaves, crunchy croutons, and a little or a lot of anchovy, as you like.
items.visualReview: 实际成品：棕色盘中拌酱罗马生菜、金黄面包丁和干酪。
items.author: Diana Chistruga

items.adjacentText: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). In a small bowl, combine 3 tablespoons (45ml) olive oil with minced garlic and whisk for 30 seconds. Transfer to a fine-mesh strainer set over a large bowl and press with the back of a spoon to extract as much oil as possible, leaving garlic behind. Reserve pressed garlic separately. Add bread cubes to garlic oil and toss to coat.
items.visualReview: 四格左上蒜与油混合，右上倒入滤筛，左下按压滤油，右下面包丁拌蒜香油；对应来源方向1。
items.author: Diana Chistruga

items.adjacentText: Add 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese, toss again, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Transfer to a rimmed baking sheet. Bake until croutons are pale golden brown and crisp, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and toss with 2 more tablespoons parmesan. Allow to cool.
items.visualReview: 四格左上面包丁加干酪，右上铺烤盘，左下烤后金黄酥脆，右下出炉再撒干酪拌匀；对应方向2。
items.author: Diana Chistruga

items.adjacentText: While croutons bake, make the dressing. Combine egg yolk, lemon juice, anchovies, Worcestershire sauce, pressed garlic, and 1/4 cup parmesan cheese in the bottom of a cup that just fits the head of an immersion blender or in the bottom of a food processor. With blender or processor running, slowly drizzle in canola oil until a smooth emulsion forms. Transfer mixture to a medium bowl. Whisking constantly, slowly drizzle in remaining 1/4 cup (60ml) extra-virgin olive oil. Season to taste generously with salt and pepper.
items.visualReview: 四格左上酱汁材料在杯底，右上手持搅拌器边搅边加油，左下中碗手动搅入橄榄油，右下加黑胡椒的乳化酱汁；对应方向3。
items.author: Diana Chistruga

items.adjacentText: To serve, toss lettuce with a few tablespoons of dressing, adding more if desired. Once lettuce is coated, add half of remaining cheese and three-quarters of croutons and toss again. Transfer to a salad bowl and sprinkle with remaining cheese and croutons. Serve.
items.visualReview: 四格左上生菜加酱，右上加干酪，左下再加面包丁，右下装盘成品；前三格是实际拌沙拉阶段，整张对应方向4。
items.author: Diana Chistruga
